headline: Microsoft Offers Voluntary Buyouts to 60,000 Employees to Cut Costs
summary: Tech giant Microsoft announced voluntary buyout packages for up to 60,000 employees, representing roughly a quarter of its global workforce, as part of cost-cutting efforts.
why: Microsoft is one of the world's largest enterprise technology companies, and major workforce adjustments reflect cost discipline amid high infrastructure investments.

impacts.name: Microsoft Corporation
impacts.why: Workforce reductions aim to lower operational costs, though severance expense and operational disruption could weigh short-term.
